settings.hero_alt: They’re taking the good shelf. All eight Evolution Companions plushes in a styled campaign scene.
settings.hero_title: You already know where they’re going.
settings.hero_body: Eight familiar little faces for the shelf you keep looking at. The complete collection is yours for $160.
settings.story_eyebrow: That spot is about to be your favorite
settings.story_title: Put your favorite in the middle. Make room for the rest.
settings.story_body: Try the bright ones together. Move the black-and-yellow one to the end. Stand back, swap two around, and look again. That’s the fun of having the whole set to arrange.
settings.size_title: That shelf is going to make you smile.
settings.size_body: Walk past, spot a little face, straighten a pair of ears. They’re the kind of collection you’ll keep stopping to look at.
settings.proof_title: Worth a closer look, even off the shelf.
settings.proof_body: The pink ribbons and purple ears are just the start. Zoom in on the little faces you’ll see every time you walk past.
settings.final_title: Give the good shelf to all eight.
settings.final_body: One complete set. Your choice of arrangement. A little more of what you love, where you can see it.
settings.point_1_body: Not tucked away behind everything else. Right where you’ll see all eight little faces.
settings.point_2_body: Swap two around. Put your favorite in the middle. Keep going until the lineup feels right.
settings.point_3_body: Move your favorite to the desk for a while. The rest of the gang can hold its place.
